Life is full of small surprises. Both of them like dumplings and juice. Tom hopes to visit Tokyo one day. Ash from the fire floated in the air.
Tom wants to be a teacher in the future. Last Friday, Tom and Mia went to the river bank. They took many photos at the plant garden. Cows give us milk.
Mia is interested in swimming. There are always many people at the plant garden. Tom spent the weekend at the library. In fact, the new printer works quickly and efficiently.
The river bank is one of the best places in the city. Tom thinks art is interesting but a little difficult. Tom bought a T-shirt at the shop yesterday.
